definition: A person who enjoys or seeks adventure
examples: The famous adventurer travelled across the desert alone.

definition: The action or power of focusing one's attention or mental effort
examples: Playing chess requires a high level of concentration.

definition: An area of open land, especially one planted with crops or pasture
examples: The children loved running through the wide green field.

definition: Someone who supports, admires, or believes in a particular person or idea
examples: The band has gained millions of followers online.

definition: To bring one's hand or a tool into contact with someone or something forcefully
examples: He used a hammer to hit the nail into the wall.

definition: Suffering from physical pain or injury
examples: He couldn't play in the final match because of his hurt knee.

definition: Used to express willingness or a lack of objection to something
examples: I don't mind walking in the rain if I have an umbrella.

definition: To continue to function well or exist for a specified period of time
examples: The movie will last for about two hours.

definition: While connected to a computer network or the internet
examples: Many people prefer to shop online rather than visit a mall.

definition: Affected with, causing, or characterized by physical pain
examples: Recovering from the surgery was a slow and painful process.

definition: A colored substance which is spread over a surface and dries to leave a thin coating
examples: She bought some blue paint to decorate her bedroom walls.

definition: A flat panel or area on an electronic device on which images and data are displayed
examples: Staring at the computer screen all day made his eyes tired.

definition: A person who secretly collects and reports information on the activities of an enemy or competitor
examples: The famous movie is about a secret spy working for the government.

definition: Having eyes that are tired from watching too much television or looking at a screen
examples: If you play video games all weekend, you'll become square-eyed.

definition: To look fixedly or vacantly at someone or something with one's eyes wide open
examples: It is considered rude to stare at people you don't know.

definition: To give assistance, encouragement, or backing to someone or something
examples: My friends always support me when I face difficult challenges.

definition: To assume particular functions, parts, or responsibilities, typically in a game, play, or team
examples: In the school play, the students will take roles of different historical figures.

definition: Having a natural aptitude or skill for something
examples: The talented musician learned to play the piano by ear.

definition: A sporting competition in which contestants play a series of games to decide the winner
examples: She won first place in the regional tennis tournament.

definition: An area of land, smaller than a forest, that is covered with growing trees
examples: We took a long, peaceful walk through the woods on Sunday.

definition: Birds that hunt and feed on other animals
examples: Eagles and falcons are powerful birds of prey with sharp talons.

definition: Astonishing or awe-inspiring in quality, so as to take one's breath away
examples: The view of the mountains from the top was absolutely breathtaking.

definition: A planned and managed breeding of animals, often to conserve an endangered species
examples: The zoo started a breeding programme to help save the giant pandas.

definition: Giving out or reflecting a lot of light; shining
examples: The bright sunlight filled the room early in the morning.

definition: A person who conquers a place or people
examples: Alexander the Great is remembered as a legendary conqueror.

definition: To plunge head first into water, or fly steeply downward through the air
examples: The eagle will fold its wings to dive down and catch its prey.

definition: A person who keeps, trains, or hunts with falcons or other birds of prey
examples: The falconer released the bird into the sky to hunt.

definition: The sport or practice of hunting with falcons or other birds of prey
examples: Falconry is an ancient tradition that requires patience and skill.

definition: The action or process of flying through the air
examples: We watched the majestic flight of the eagle over the canyon.

definition: A steady, intent look
examples: She turned her gaze toward the distant mountains.

definition: The fact of being who or what a person or thing is
examples: Traditional clothing is an important part of their national identity.

definition: The action of inventing something, typically a process or device
examples: The invention of the internet completely changed how we communicate.

definition: Relating to or characteristic of a nation; common to a whole nation
examples: The golden eagle is considered a national symbol in many countries.

definition: Feeling deep pleasure or satisfaction as a result of one's own achievements or qualities
examples: His parents were very proud of him when he graduated from college.

definition: To come or go back to a place or person
examples: The trained bird will always return to the falconer's glove.

definition: A nature reserve or safe place for animals to live protected
examples: The injured owl was taken to a wildlife sanctuary to recover.

definition: To fly or rise high in the air
examples: The eagle spread its wings and began to soar above the clouds.

definition: A mark, character, or object used as a conventional representation of something
examples: The dove is widely recognized as a symbol of peace.

definition: To become interested or engaged in a pursuit, hobby, or profession
examples: He decided to take up photography in his free time.

definition: The maximum extent across the wings of a bird, insect, or airplane, measured from tip to tip
examples: The condor is a huge bird with a wingspan of up to three meters.

definition: An even distribution of weight enabling someone or something to remain upright and steady
examples: Gymnasts need incredible balance to perform on the beam.

definition: To unite or merge to form a single unit or substance
examples: The recipe asks you to combine flour, sugar, and butter in a bowl.

definition: The practice of training people to obey rules or a code of behavior
examples: Martial arts teach respect, self-control, and discipline.

definition: To share interests, experiences, or other characteristics with someone or something
examples: My brother and I have a lot in common, especially our love for music.

definition: In a good physical or mental condition; promoting good health
examples: Eating vegetables and exercising regularly will keep you healthy.

definition: Of the most recent date; the newest
examples: He always buys the latest gadgets as soon as they are released.

definition: The way in which a person or group lives
examples: Moving to the countryside required a major change in their lifestyle.

definition: Various sports or skills, mainly of Japanese or Chinese origin, that originated as forms of self-defense
examples: Judo and karate are popular forms of martial arts.

definition: An activity that someone does regularly for enjoyment rather than work
examples: Reading mystery novels is her favorite pastime on weekends.

definition: A state of health and well-being, usually achieved through proper nutrition and exercise
examples: Swimming is excellent for improving your overall physical fitness.

definition: A feeling of deep admiration for someone or something elicited by their abilities, qualities, or achievements
examples: The students have a great deal of respect for their history teacher.

definition: Fashion that is considered to have emerged not from studios, but from grassroots streetwear
examples: Baggy pants and sneakers are key elements of modern street fashion.

definition: A sudden feeling of excitement and pleasure
examples: Riding the fastest roller coaster in the park gave him a huge thrill.

definition: A session of vigorous physical exercise or training
examples: He does a 30-minute workout at the gym every morning before work.

definition: To begin to be
examples: If you practice every day, you will eventually become a great piano player.

definition: To have or hold someone or something within
examples: This wooden box contains all of my childhood toys.

definition: A person who takes little or no exercise and watches a lot of television
examples: Instead of being a couch potato all weekend, let's go for a hike.

definition: A natural oily or greasy substance occurring in animal bodies, or a macronutrient in food
examples: Fast food often contains a high amount of unhealthy fat.

definition: As a substitute or alternative to; rather than
examples: Let's order a pizza tonight instead of cooking dinner.

definition: Food that has low nutritional value, typically produced in the form of packaged snacks
examples: Eating too much junk food like chips and candy can affect your health.

definition: A large or sufficient amount or quantity; more than enough
examples: Don't rush; we still have plenty of time before the train leaves.

definition: A nonalcoholic beverage, typically carbonated and sweetened
examples: I ordered a burger, fries, and a cold soft drink.

definition: Having a pleasant, distinct flavor
examples: The chef prepared a very tasty pasta dish for dinner.

definition: A melody, especially one which characterizes a certain piece of music
examples: He was humming a catchy tune while walking down the street.
